name: Tradable APAC Diversified Finance Provider SSTN
oneLiner: PC0000033 is a KYC-gated Tradable senior secured term note on an APAC diversified finance provider; contract-priced at $1 par, not a liquid stablecoin.
collateral: Senior secured term notes linked to an APAC diversified finance provider and tokenized through Tradable private-credit issuance rails.
pegMechanism: Contract-priced at $1.00 note par rather than a liquid secondary-market peg; investors rely on issuer servicing and note repayment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PC0000033 is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

notices.title: Contract-priced private credit
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live $1 price and market cap but zero 24h volume; Pharos treats this as a par-valued private-credit note rather than a liquid stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: PC0000033 is a Tradable-issued senior secured term note on zkSync; tokens are minted only by Tradable's permissioned, KYC/KYB-gated issuance contracts for verified investors against the underlying APAC private-credit deal.

controls.label: Tradable issuance/deal-representation contracts (zkSync)
controls.evidence: Tradable operates permissioned smart contracts for deal representation with AML/KYC/KYB/KYT gating; primary issuance of the note token is controlled by Tradable for verified investors, with no permissionless mint.

review.evidence: Tradable tokenizes institutional private-credit deals on zkSync through permissioned, compliance-gated issuance contracts; the note is minted by Tradable's issuer rails for KYC/KYB-verified investors and is contract-priced at $1 par with no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain minter/admin role on the zkSync note contract before raising confidence.
